feedback: Your essay presents a clear and sensible position regarding the use of cellphones in the classroom. You have identified the key tension between the educational benefits of technology and the potential for distraction. Overall, you have a solid foundation; focus on expanding your analysis and refining your sentence variety to elevate your work to the next level.
